Details.title: Details
Details.description: The full Budget Billing payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this: {"title":"Smooth out your bill","subtitle":"Budget Billing keeps your payment the same every month","currency":"USD","monthlyAmount":118,"currentAvgText":"Your bills now swing $64–$210","termText":"Recalculated every 12 months","series":{"actual":[96,120,168,210,150,88,64,72,110,175,190,140],"budget":118},"bullets":["No surprises in peak season","Cancel anytime","Settles up once a year"],"submitText":"Enroll in Budget Billing","submitValue":"Enroll me in Budget Billing","secondaryText":"Maybe later","secondaryValue":"I'd like to think about Budget Billing"} Rules: - 'title' (string, optional): heading. Defaults to 'Smooth out your bill'. - 'subtitle' (string, optional): one short line under the title. - 'currency' (string, optional): ISO code, default USD. - 'monthlyAmount' (number, optional): the flat monthly payment; rendered large. - 'currentAvgText' (string, optional): describes today's swing, e.g. 'Your bills now swing $64–$210'. - 'termText' (string, optional): plan terms, e.g. 'Recalculated every 12 months'. - 'series' (object, optional): { 'actual' (array of 6–12 numbers = recent monthly bills), 'budget' (number = the flat line) }. Rendered as a jagged actual line vs a flat budget line. Omit to hide the chart. - 'bullets' (array of strings, optional): benefit checklist (2–4 items). - 'submitText' (string, optional): primary button label, e.g. 'Enroll in Budget Billing'. - 'submitValue' (string, optional): message sent back on enroll; defaults to the label. - 'secondaryText' (string, optional): secondary/ghost button label, e.g. 'Maybe later'. - 'secondaryValue' (string, optional): message sent back for the secondary button; defaults to the label. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
